recognize_zh: 電子顯微鏡下，細胞質內可見由多層平行膜片與其間排列規則的核糖體組成的長柱狀結構，即核糖體－板層複合體（ribosome-lamella complex），是毛狀細胞白血病的超微結構特徵之一。
features: Transmission electron micrograph (ultrastructure), not light microscopy
Elongated cylindrical cytoplasmic structure of concentric/parallel lamellae
Regularly spaced ribosomes lining the lamellae (ribosome-lamella complex)
Scattered mitochondria and free ribosomes in surrounding cytoplasm
describe_en: Transmission electron micrograph shows part of a cell with a nucleus on the left and an elongated cytoplasmic inclusion composed of parallel membranous lamellae studded with regularly arranged ribosomes. Several mitochondria are present adjacent to the structure. This represents a ribosome-lamella complex. Findings are consistent with hairy cell leukemia, in which this structure is found in a subset of cases, although it is not entirely specific.

ddx.dx: Rough endoplasmic reticulum stacks (e.g., plasma cells)
ddx.vs: RER forms flattened cisternae with ribosomes on the outer surface only and lacks the tubular cylindrical arrangement of the ribosome-lamella complex.

ddx.dx: Other B-cell lymphomas with rare ribosome-lamella complexes
ddx.vs: RLCs are occasionally reported in other lymphoproliferative disorders, so diagnosis rests on BRAF V600E, CD103/CD25/CD11c/annexin A1 and TRAP rather than ultrastructure alone.
